text:
The evidence can't tell us about 2026. The data series ends in 2025 (latest observed year), so nothing in it covers 2026.

For 2021–2025, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within ASSET-C (374.8 ha), with valid observations across the entire asset. For context, about 48.4 ha had tree cover in 2000, and about 43.3 ha (11.55% of the property) was forest in 2020.

Limits on this finding:
- "Not detected" doesn't mean no change at all. Changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed.
- It is not a regulatory or compliance finding (e.g., EUDR).
- It says nothing about anything outside 2021–2025.

To answer for 2026, you would need a data source or update covering that year.
